parameters.jsCode: const crypto = require('crypto'); const item = $input.first().json; const headers = item.headers || {}; const ts = Number(headers['x-nexamart-timestamp']); const signature = String(headers['x-nexamart-signature'] || ''); const raw = typeof item.body === 'string' ? item.body : JSON.stringify(item.body); const now = Math.floor(Date.now()/1000); const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(`${ts}.${raw}`).digest('hex'); const valid = Number.isSafeInteger(ts) && Math.abs(now-ts) <= 300 && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(signature) && crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected,'hex'), Buffer.from(signature,'hex')); if (!valid) return [{json:{ok:false,statusCode:401,error:'Invalid signature or timestamp'}}]; let event; try { event = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return [{json:{ok:false,statusCode:400,error:'Invalid JSON'}}]; } const allowed = ['cod.order.created','cod.order.confirmed','cod.order.dispatched','cod.order.delivered_collected','cod.order.delivery_failed','cod.order.returned']; if (!event.eventId || !allowed.includes(event.eventType)) return [{json:{ok:false,statusCode:400,error:'Invalid event'}}]; const seen = $getWorkflowStaticData('global'); if (seen[event.eventId]) return [{json:{ok:true,duplicate:true,eventType:event.eventType,eventId:event.eventId}}]; seen[event.eventId] = Date.now(); for (const [key,value] of Object.entries(seen)) if (Date.now()-value > 86400000) delete seen[key]; return [{json:{ok:true,duplicate:false,eventType:event.eventType,eventId:event.eventId,reference:event.reference,orderId:event.orderId,sellerId:event.sellerId,amount:event.amount,currency:event.currency,orderStatus:event.orderStatus,paymentStatus:event.paymentStatus}}];
for (const item of $input.all()) if (!item.json.duplicate) console.log('NexaMart COD operator event', JSON.stringify(item.json)); return $input.all();
